about: Replay each sequence: start from `start`, apply every step's `answer` in order, and compare the document to `expect` after each. Documents compare as JSON values (object key order is free). Cursors are opaque: carry them, never read them. These answers carry `people_on`; a document has a `people` key exactly while its latest answer said so.

steps.name: an author moves the cook: put people, no known op
a person's fact changes: put people
a person is carried into another room: place follows the carrier
a new person appears: put people
the drifter's only fact is retracted: del people
the view gains a fact and a person moves: put known and put people

sequences.name: mode change: people on, then off

steps.name: reset, the people key is removed

sequences.name: mode change: people off, then on

steps.name: a person's posture changes: put people
reset from nothing: no handles, no present layer
